origins.name: Weir-Port Arrival
origins.description: You woke on the rain-slick timbers of Ferry-Weir Quay with a fractured tally and an instinct for reading murky water.
origins.perks: +1 Wisdom, +1 Perception skill, +5 reputation with The Oar-Keepers' Union.

origins.name: Brass-Works Debtor
origins.description: Forged beneath roaring chimney-stacks and clanging coinage presses in the lower Chancery terraces.
origins.perks: +1 Endurance, +1 Athletics skill, +5 reputation with The Quiet Reformers.

origins.name: Conservatory Ward
origins.description: Raised among bottled memories and whispering lens-grinders of the Mnemonic Collegium.
origins.perks: +1 Intelligence, +1 Mythology & Lore skill, +5 reputation with The Mnemonic Collegium.

origins.name: Pale Reach Wanderer
origins.description: You walked beyond the Lantern-Wall across the salt-flats and came back with your true name intact.
origins.perks: +1 Agility, +1 Survival skill, +5 reputation with The Pale Frontier Wardens.

origins.name: Crucible-Wharf Apprentice
origins.description: You spent your first Threshold seasons pumping bellows beside untaxed independent smiths.
origins.perks: +1 Strength, +1 Investigation skill, +5 reputation with The Oar-Keepers' Union.

origins.name: Velvet-Court Exile
origins.description: Once privy to high-society ledger auctions until you saw the human cost behind the brass scales.
origins.perks: +1 Charisma, +1 Persuasion skill, +5 reputation with The Unstamped Freebooters.
